Frequently Asked Questions about Zanzibar Tours

Do I need to book tours in advance?

For popular activities (Safari Blue, Mnemba snorkeling, Jozani Forest), book 1–3 days ahead in peak season. Stone Town walks and spice tours can often be arranged same-day.

Can I customize tour durations?

Yes — most tours are flexible. Morning or afternoon departures, add visits, extend to full-day. WhatsApp us to discuss.

Are marine park fees included?

Yes — Menai Bay ($10) and Mnemba ($25) conservation fees are included in our tour prices. Other entry fees (museums, Jozani park) are noted where not included.

What if the weather is bad?

Marine tours may be rescheduled for safety. We offer flexible rebooking or full refunds if conditions prevent departure.
